candidates.requirement: The scanner target must be able to scan flow collections using a supported nesting limit above the default 1000.
candidates.target_route: Call yaml_set_max_nest_level(2000), then scan a balanced flow sequence of 1500 '[' bytes followed by 1500 ']' bytes.
candidates.failure_condition: The old target never changes the limit. At its default of 1000, the scanner rejects the 1001st opening bracket and the target exits the scan loop.
candidates.alternative_paths: Changing input bytes cannot change MAX_NESTING_LEVEL. The target has one scan sequence and no setter call; reaching the same guard at the default threshold does not exercise acceptance under the supported higher limit.
